# Interface fonts

Inter and Outfit are bundled locally so the interface does not depend on a font CDN.
Both variable fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the complete
license and copyright notices are included beside each font.

Official sources:
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/outfit

Retrieved on 2026-10-10. Inter includes optical size and weight axes; Outfit includes
the weight axis. The interface uses the normal styles and weights 100–900.
